g.text: Policy changes improved some returns; total profit remains negative
Evaluation: 11-15 September 2026 | 25 contracts | Five stations | Exploratory reused dates
* Fixed LLM + 50% market blend was selected on September 6-9 development results only.
All 23 tested variants are retained in the report. Displayed-price scenarios assume full fills; quantities are unavailable.
Each alternative: $50 starting cash, $40 reserve, maximum $2 per entry / five shares. No extra cloud calls.
Overhead: $39.17 per alternative at $200/month through settlement; separate from trading cash.
Scenarios are not confidence intervals. Entry rechecks can cancel different trades at different price stresses.
